summary: New S1 found by the 22-28 re-grade. A V3 snipe sends the whole amount as ETH and never asks the router for the unused part back. If the pool can only fill part of the buy, the unused ETH stays in the Uniswap router, where anyone can take it. Candidate: the router and pool are standard Uniswap contracts not in this repository, so a Phase 23 fork test must prove it on a real thin pool. The per-trade loss is capped at the snipe amount.
